name: Validate  Report
query:
SELECT 
    e.name AS employee_id,
    e.employee_name,
    e.branch,
    COALESCE(COUNT(a.name), 0) AS attendance_days
FROM 
    `tabEmployee` e
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabAttendance` a 
    ON a.employee = e.name 
    AND a.attendance_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
WHERE 
    e.branch = %(branch)s  
    AND e.status= 'Active'
GROUP BY 
    e.name, e.employee_name, e.branch
ORDER BY 
    e.employee_name
